2608.09992.title: Knowledge-Guided 3D CT Generation: A Conditioning-Centric Taxonomy
2608.09992.paper_summary: Controllable generation guided by external knowledge is a key requirement in modern generative deep learning applications, enabling the synthesis of samples with explicit constraints on semantic content, structural properties, and variability. In 3D Computed Tomography (CT), such control is essential for clinical applications, including data augmentation, privacy-preserving data sharing, and the simulation of specific anatomical or pathological scenarios. While research on conditional 3D CT generation has expanded rapidly, the diversity of existing approaches makes systematic comparison difficult and obscures fundamental design choices. In this survey, we propose a conditioning-centric taxonomy that organizes the literature along three orthogonal dimensions: the type of external knowledge (K), the knowledge integration paradigm (I), and the generative architecture (A). This factorization defines an explicit design space (K x I x A) that provides a unified perspective on prior work. Using this framework, we systematize existing methods, identify dominant trends and recurring design patterns, and highlight underexplored regions of the design space that point toward promising directions for future research.
2608.09992.paper_summary_zh: 可控生成由外部知識引導是現代生成深度學習應用中的一項關鍵需求，使得可以合成具有明確約束的樣本，包括語義內容、結構特性和變異性。在三維計算機斷層掃描（CT）中，這種控制對於臨床應用至關重要，包括數據增強、隱私保護的數據共享以及特定解剖或病理場景的模擬。儘管有關條件三維CT生成的研究迅速擴展，但現有方法的多樣性使得系統比較變得困難，並模糊了基本的設計選擇。在本調查中，我們提出了一種以條件為中心的分類法，沿著三個正交維度組織文獻：外部知識的類型（K）、知識整合範式（I）和生成架構（A）。這種因式分解定義了一個明確的設計空間（K x I x A），為先前的工作提供了一個統一的視角。利用這一框架，我們系統化現有方法，識別主導趨勢和重複的設計模式，並突顯設計空間中尚未充分探索的區域，指向未來研究的有希望方向。
